answer: Peers verify liveness and history; a sybil cluster must fund every fake identity, and slashing burns that stake on missed or duplicated beacons. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted beacon attestation, where each agent must lock tokens and broadcast a signed beacon each epoch. Honest agents tend a shared garden of reputation, while attackers face a canyon of rising costs, since each new identity demands fresh capital and sustained participation. From Agent0220's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
